# cidaas_app (Resource)

The `cidaas_app` resource in the provider is used to define and manage clients/applications within the Cidaas system for **cidaas v3.x** tenants.

> **Note for v4.x (Trustdesk) Tenants:** For cidaas v4.x, use **[`cidaas_app_configuration`](app_configuration.md)** instead.

Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:apps_read
- cidaas:apps_write
- cidaas:apps_delete

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example configuration for cidaas_app on v3.x tenants:
resource "cidaas_app" "sample_app" {
  client_name = "sample_app"
  client_type = "SINGLE_PAGE"
  company_name = "Widas"
  client_id = "sample_app_client_id"
  client_secret = "sample_app_client_secret"
  redirect_uris = [
    "https://example.com/callback"
  ]
  allowed_logout_urls = [
    "https://example.com/logout"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_name` (String) The name of the client.
- `client_type` (String) The type of the client. The allowed types are `SINGLE_PAGE`, `REGULAR_WEB`, `NON_INTERACTIVE`, `ANDROID`, `IOS`.
- `company_name` (String) The name of the company.

### Optional

- `accept_roles_in_the_registration` (Boolean) Accept roles in the registration. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.
- `accessTokenValiditySeconds` (Number)
- `account_deactivation_reason_required` (Boolean) Boolean flag to specify whether account deactivation reason is required or not.
- `ad_providers` (Attributes List) A list of Active Directory identity providers that users can authenticate with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ad_providers))
- `allow_disposable_email` (Boolean) if set to `true` users can register with disposable email address. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.
- `allow_guest_login_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allow_guest_login_groups))
- `allow_login_with` (Set of String) The allowed login mediums. The allowed values are `EMAIL`, `MOBILE`, `USER_NAME`.
- `allow_net_work_initiation` (Boolean)
- `allowed_groups` (Attributes List) A list of groups that are allowed to access the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_groups))
- `allowed_logout_urls` (Set of String) A set of allowed logout URLs for OAuth2 client.
- `allowed_fields` (Set of String) The allowed fields while registering to the client.
- `allowed_web_origins` (Set of String) Web origins allowed for CORS requests.
- `always_ask_mfa` (Boolean)
- `auto_login_after_register` (Boolean)
- `bot_detection` (Boolean)
- `cidaas_user_device_id` (String)
- `client_id` (String) The unique identifier of the client.
- `client_secret` (String) The secret key of the client.
- `custom_providers` (Attributes List) A list of custom identity providers that users can authenticate with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_providers))
- `description` (String) The description of the client.
- `enable_deduplication` (Boolean) if set to `true` deduplication is enabled for the client. Default is set to `false` while creating an app.
- `grant_types` (Set of String) The grant types allowed for the client.
- `group_role_restriction` (Attributes) Configuration for group role restrictions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_role_restriction))
- `group_selection` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_selection))
- `hosted_page_group` (String)
- `is_group_role_restriction_enabled` (Boolean) Specifies whether group role restrictions are enabled for the client. Default is `false`.
- `is_login_spi_configured` (Boolean)
- `is_one_time_payment_integration_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_sub_subscription_integration_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_totp_reset_enable` (Boolean)
- `logo_align` (String)
- `logo_url` (String) The URL to the logo of the client.
- `mfa` (Attributes) Multi-Factor Authentication configuration for the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mfa))
- `mobile_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_settings))
- `operations_allowed_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operations_allowed_groups))
- `password_policy` (String) The id of the password policy to be configured for the client. Default is set to system default policy.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Redirect URIs for OAuth2 client.
- `required_fields` (Set of String) The required fields while registering to the client.
- `response_types` (Set of String) The response types of the client.
- `template_group_id` (String) The id of the template group to be configured for communication. Default is set to the system default group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import identifier in this command is the client_id of the app to be imported.

terraform import cidaas_app.sample client_id
```
